Definition: a Jechielite or descendant of Jechiel
BiblicalUsage: The Jehielites were the sons of Jehiel of the house of Laadan, chief fathers among the Gershonites. Their sons Zetham and Joel were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God trusts a family with His treasures, and the sons of Jehiel kept the house.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
